title: HTTP Request
description: Makes HTTP requests to public API endpoints, like curl for agents.
The agent provides the request (method, URL, headers, body); credentials come per call or from the node config, where ${ROCKETRIDE_*} placeholders resolve on the engine.
The node blocks non-public network destinations, returns 3xx responses without following them automatically, and enforces URL patterns and enabled HTTP methods.

http_request.whitelistPattern.title: URL Pattern (regex)
http_request.whitelistPattern.description: Applied with Python regex match() to the final canonical URL after path substitution, regular query parameters, and query-based API-key auth. After matching, a fail-closed source grammar requires a literal HTTP(S) scheme; an exact literal/escaped DNS, IPv4, or bracketed-IPv6 host (or a (hostA|hostB) / (?:hostA|hostB) host alternation group) with an optional exact or [0-9]-based port policy, or a whole-authority [^/] policy; and an explicit path, query, or end boundary. Unsupported or ambiguous authority regex syntax is denied at request time. Example: ^https://(?:api\.a\.com|api\.b\.com)(?::[0-9]+)?(?:/|$). Scheme-only prefixes are denied; use an empty whitelist to allow all public destinations. Blank placeholder rows are ignored.

http_request.urlWhitelist.title: URL Whitelist
http_request.urlWhitelist.description: Python regex patterns applied with match() to the final canonical URL after path substitution, regular query parameters, and query-based API-key auth. A request-time source recognizer accepts exact literal/escaped hosts (including (hostA|hostB) / (?:hostA|hostB) host alternation groups) with supported numeric-port forms, or a deliberate [^/] whole-authority form, followed by an explicit authority boundary. Unsupported or ambiguous authority syntax fails closed even when the regex matches. [] or only blank placeholder rows allows all public destinations; non-public destinations remain blocked. Blank rows mixed with valid patterns are ignored; invalid non-empty regexes, non-string values, and malformed entries fail closed.

http_request.authType.title: Authentication
http_request.authType.description: Credential applied to every request this node sends. Set it here with a ${ROCKETRIDE_*} placeholder (resolved on the engine from the org, team, and user environment) instead of passing tokens per call. When set, the URL whitelist must be non-empty and every pattern must pin one exact https host, and per-call auth is rejected.

http_request.authToken.title: Bearer token
http_request.authToken.description: Sent as "Authorization: Bearer <token>" when Authentication is Bearer token. Use a placeholder such as ${ROCKETRIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN} so the secret never leaves the engine.

http_request.authPassword.title: Basic auth password
http_request.authPassword.description: Used when Authentication is Basic. A ${ROCKETRIDE_*} placeholder keeps it on the engine.

http_request.authHeaderName.title: API key header name
http_request.authHeaderName.description: Header that carries the key when Authentication is API key header, e.g. X-API-Key.

http_request.authHeaderValue.title: API key value
http_request.authHeaderValue.description: Value sent in the API key header. A ${ROCKETRIDE_*} placeholder keeps it on the engine.

http_request.defaultHeaders.title: Default headers
http_request.defaultHeaders.description: Headers sent with every request, e.g. Accept or X-GitHub-Api-Version. A per-call header with the same name (case-insensitive) replaces the default. Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie, Host, Content-Type, Content-Length, and Transfer-Encoding are not allowed here; credentials belong in the Authentication fields. Non-empty default headers require the same pinned https whitelist as Authentication. Blank rows are ignored.

http_request.rateLimitPerSecond.title: Max requests per second
http_request.rateLimitPerSecond.description: Maximum number of HTTP requests allowed per second. Uses a token-bucket algorithm for smooth enforcement.

http_request.rateLimitPerMinute.title: Max requests per minute
http_request.rateLimitPerMinute.description: Maximum number of HTTP requests allowed per minute. Provides a broader throttle beyond the per-second limit.

http_request.maxConcurrentRequests.title: Max concurrent requests
http_request.maxConcurrentRequests.description: Maximum number of HTTP requests that can be in-flight simultaneously.
